Quantinuum and SoftBank Corp. have jointly released a white paper detailing strategies for scaling practical quantum computing use cases as the technology approaches the fault‑tolerant era. The document outlines a roadmap for addressing key technical and economic challenges to achieve quantum advantage in industry applications. The release was reported by The Manila Times and summarised by Google News.
